data.name: Valken
data.detailed_description:
VALKEN is a realistic solo tactical shooter where you step into the role of a lone operative infiltrating a secretive military organization.

No backup. No reinforcements. No second chances.

Every mission is a high-risk infiltration where stealth, precision, and tactical decision-making determine survival. Gather intelligence, eliminate targets, and adapt to hostile environments where every mistake has consequences.

GAME MODES

  • Story Campaign – A narrative-driven solo experience focused on infiltration, survival, and tactical operations

  • Zombie Extraction Missions – High-intensity rescue scenarios where you must locate and extract survivors under extreme threat conditions

KEY FEATURES

  • Solo tactical gameplay blending stealth and intense combat in both FPS and TPS perspectives

  • Vertical level design featuring climbing and full environmental traversal

  • Highly detailed, immersive environments built for infiltration and tactical approaches

  • Photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 visuals with dynamic lighting and atmospheric tension

  • Reactive AI that adapts to noise, movement, and player strategy

data.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB / AMD RX 6700 XT

content_descriptors.notes:
VALKEN contains realistic and intense violence as part of its tactical combat gameplay. Players engage in armed encounters using firearms, resulting in frequent combat situations where enemies can be injured or killed. Some scenes may depict blood and realistic combat effects.

Throughout the experience, players may encounter high-tension scenarios involving life-or-death decisions, including infiltration of hostile environments and survival against overwhelming threats. The narrative may include themes of military operations, psychological stress, and moral pressure in extreme situations.

VALKEN does not focus on drug use, alcohol abuse, or self-harm as gameplay elements, though these themes are not the central focus of the experience.
